description:
Refactor the 'invalid' boolean field in the Order class to 'valid'. You must invert the logic (so that 'true' becomes 'false' and vice versa) and update all usages across the project. 

Starting state: The project 'order-processing-system' is open. The class `com.example.orders.model.Order` has a field `private boolean invalid`. 

Goal: 
1. Rename the field to `valid`.
2. Invert the logic of all accessors and usages (e.g. `isInvalid()` becomes `isValid()` or `!isValid()`).
3. Ensure the project compiles and all tests pass.

Recommended: Use IntelliJ's 'Invert Boolean' refactoring tool (Refactor > Invert Boolean) to automate this safely.
